description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Pipe' that provides static methods for composing and combining Akka Stream components such as Flow graphs, filters, sinks, and flows. It contains methods for joining filtered sinks, unhandled sinks, filtered flows, and chaining multiple flows, facilitating complex stream processing pipelines within the Akka framework.

classes.name: Pipe
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to compose and join Akka stream components such as filters, sinks, and flows.

methods.name: joinFilteredSink
methods.description: Creates a graph that joins a filter graph with a sink to the filter's output port, producing a flow that includes the filtered and sink-joined processing.

methods.name: joinUnhandledSink
methods.description: Creates a graph that joins a filter graph with an unhandled messages sink to the filter's unhandled port.

methods.name: joinFilteredFlow
methods.description: Joins a filter graph with an inner flow, allowing messages passing through the filter to be processed by the flow, and returning a combined fan-out shape.

methods.name: joinFlows
methods.description: Chains multiple flow graphs sequentially into a single flow.
